picture_story_s3.title: The Complete Butterfly Life Cycle (S3 5-Panel Standard)
picture_story_s3.prompt_en: Look at the five pictures. Tell a story about Oliver and Sophia raising a monarch butterfly. Write 40 or more words.

panels.image_prompt: 3D Pixar animation style: Two cute students Oliver (neat dark hair, green polo shirt) and Sophia (wavy brown hair, pink sweater) looking through hand lenses at a tiny butterfly egg on a broad milkweed leaf in the sunny school garden, morning light, macro detail.
panels.caption: Oliver and Sophia discovered a tiny round egg resting on a garden leaf.
panels.sentence_frame: First, Oliver and Sophia discovered a tiny egg on a broad green leaf.

panels.image_prompt: 3D Pixar animation style: A plump, friendly black-yellow-white striped monarch caterpillar chewing fresh green leaves inside an airy classroom terrarium, Oliver and Sophia smiling beside the jar.
panels.caption: A striped caterpillar hatched from the egg and fed on fresh green leaves.
panels.sentence_frame: Next, a striped caterpillar hatched and fed on fresh leaves.

panels.image_prompt: 3D Pixar animation style: A smooth jade-green chrysalis with tiny golden dots hanging upside down from a twig under the lid of the observation box, calm peaceful atmosphere, gentle room lighting.
panels.caption: The caterpillar formed a peaceful chrysalis to undergo metamorphosis.
panels.sentence_frame: After that, it formed a green chrysalis and stayed very quiet.

panels.image_prompt: 3D Pixar animation style: A newly emerged monarch butterfly clinging to its empty transparent shell, pumping fluid into its damp orange-and-black patterned wings as Oliver and Sophia watch in amazement.
panels.caption: The butterfly split the chrysalis shell and pumped fluid to expand its wings.
panels.sentence_frame: Then, the adult butterfly emerged and carefully unfolded its wet wings.

panels.title_en: Scene 5: Free in the Flower Garden
panels.image_prompt: 3D Pixar animation style: The magnificent orange and black monarch butterfly soaring joyfully into the clear blue sky above a vibrant flowerbed, Oliver and Sophia cheering with outstretched arms, bright sunny afternoon.
panels.caption: Finally, the magnificent butterfly took flight across the school garden toward the blooming flowers.
panels.sentence_frame: Finally, the magnificent butterfly spread its strong wings and flew freely into the garden.
